description: Eastern border patrol sweep covering high-traffic commercial strips along Lakeshore Road East and public waterfront access points leading to Lakefront Promenade.
area_type: Commercial Retail Strips, Public Waterfront Parks, Marina Facilities, Mixed-Use Service Plazas.
start_point: Head West on Lakeshore Rd E at Dixie Rd (City of Toronto / Peel Boundary).
focus: Non-illuminated storefront signs, outdated or faded plaza pylon panels, weathered boat launch and marina signage, and high-visibility retail building face updates.
hotspots: Waterfront Trail Parking Lots, Lakeshore East Commercial Strips, Haig Blvd Retail Pocket, Lakefront Promenade Park & Marina.
turn_by_turn:
1. START: Head West on Lakeshore Rd E at Dixie Rd.
2. Turn LEFT (South) onto Haig Blvd (Drive park access perimeter).
3. Turn RIGHT (West) onto Lakefront Promenade (Loop marina parking facilities and public boat launches back to Lakeshore Rd E).
4. Turn LEFT (West) onto Lakeshore Rd E.
5. Turn RIGHT (North) onto Cawthra Rd.
6. END / LOOP EXIT: North on Cawthra Rd to Atwater Ave.

route_name: Lorne Park & Jack Darling Park Transition Zone

start_point: Head West on Lakeshore Rd W at Mississauga Rd.
focus: Weathered neighborhood plaza monument signs, damaged awning lettering, non-illuminated store fascias, and commercial entrance sign refreshes.
hotspots: Jack Darling Memorial Park Perimeter, Lorne Park Rd Service Plazas, Indian Rd Commercial Cluster, Public Lake Access Points.
turn_by_turn:

3. Turn RIGHT (West) onto Lakeshore Rd W.
4. Turn LEFT (South) into Jack Darling Park Main Entrance / Park Rd (Drive perimeter parking loop back to Lakeshore Rd W).
5. Turn LEFT (West) onto Lakeshore Rd W.
6. Turn RIGHT (North) onto Indian Rd.
7. Turn LEFT (West) onto Truscott Dr.
8. END / LOOP EXIT: West on Truscott Dr to Southdown Rd.
